item.title: Danced religion at halftime
item.description: Bad Bunny swerved, subverting everyone’s expectations of a political statement. Since it was announced in September that Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio (Bad Bunny) would be the halftime performer for Super Bowl LX, the question being asked was, “What political statement will Bad Bunny make?”

item.title: February 22 Lent 1A Matthew 4 1 11
item.description: A doctor buddy of mine, who is no biblical literalist, is nonetheless convinced that the story of Jesus in the wilderness is both factual and true. His assumption is that this wilderness is the same wilderness Jesus traversed in search of John, full of the selfsame angels and beasts and temptations, only unseen until after he found his cousin and was baptized by him.

item.title: Jesse Jackson dies at 84
item.description: Jesse Jackson Sr., a longtime civil rights activist who twice vied for the Democratic presidential nomination in the 1980s, died February 17 at age 84. A protégé of Martin Luther King Jr., Jackson was the founder of the Rainbow PUSH Coalition, a social justice organization, but he intertwined his advocacy with politics and diplomacy, serving as a special envoy to Africa for the Clinton administration and as a shadow senator representing Washington, DC, in the 1990s.

item.title: Children of Gaza
item.description: Like lost children we live our unfinished adventures. —Guy Debord A child plots her life till the endthen spends the rest of her daystrying to remember it Cities like rooms in abandonedbuildings, addresses carved innotebooks lost on bombed staircases
